title: test(spec): the six reader-bound needles move with their readers, naming each cited decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 31)
body:
Part of #20749
Clause-②: no

Stage 31 of this card, the needles stage: answer A in the seat's ACCEPT `6074213330`, under the claim `6084058576`. Six test strings carried a tracker id that a reader matches. Each one moves with its reader in this PR, and the match stays exactly as strong: the new words sit in the same reader places the old id did. Three class (e) strings that regrew since stage 30 drop a number: two titles that already explain it, and one ledger `why:` value that keeps its ruling record id (the claim amendment in ACCEPT `6085085283`). Text only: no schema shape, key, `.describe()` string or behaviour moves.

## Census, re-taken at the base

Stage 28's `census28.cjs`, byte-identical (md5 `31d8488b…`), calibrated first against nine published readings, all reproduced exactly: 128/130, 191/200 and 73/76 (stages 27 to 28), 73/76 and 16/17 (stage 29's base and head), 17/18 and 10/10 (stage 30's base and head), 17/18 at `e75dceddd` and 10/10 at stage 30's landing `961d365f1`.

At the base `e148ca984`: **13 messages / 13 ids in 10 files** (titles 2/2, other 11/11).

- the 6 reader-bound strings (moved here);
- the 4 CSS hex colours that stage 21's ACCEPT kept (`ui/dashboard-chart-structure-refusal.test.ts:94` x2, `ui/dashboard.test.ts:124` x2);
- 3 regrown since stage 30's landing:
  - 2 titles from PR 22315 (`automation/end-node-outcome.test.ts:67`, `automation/io-node-config.test.ts:472`), rewritten here;
  - 1 ledger `why:` value from PR 22425 (`system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:497`). The claim amendment in ACCEPT `6085085283` admitted it, and the patch round rewrote it: `#22211 A` becomes `letter A`, and the ruling record id it cites stays.

At the head `a766d439f`: **4 / 4 in 2 files**, the 4 hex colours only, which is the card's end state. Titles 0/0. (`fbec38c32`, before the patch round, read 5 / 5 in 3 files.)

No file is deferred. At 15:45Z there were 11 open PRs (418 file rows, each list complete against the PR's `changed_files`). None touches any of the 14 files in this diff, or the 3 files that still carry an id. The lit control, `ui/component.zod.ts`, is found in 2 of them (22421 and 22496).

## The six pairs

Each needle and every reader place it matched move together, one span per line. "Places" are the reader lines where the needle matched inside the exact text the test reads.

| pair | test string | reader | needle, base → head | reader places, base → head |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| P1 | `ai/build-progress.test.ts:236` | `ai/build-progress.zod.ts`, the whole file (`SOURCE`) | `cloud#2172` → `the cloud build-progress card` | 8, 27, 77, 84, 108, 123, 177 → the same seven |
| P2 | `ai/build-progress.test.ts:237` | the same file | `objectui#7388 block 2` → `block 2 of the objectui build-panel card` | 85 → 85 |
| P3 | `contracts/approval-service.test.ts:274` | the `continueRestoredRun` docblock in `contracts/approval-service.ts` | `#16495` → `the automation-service contract` | 999 → 999 |
| P4 | `ui/notification.test.ts:123`, plus its own anti-vacuity regex at `:134` | the tombstone note label in `ui/notification.zod.ts` | `// [#4610]` → `// [dual-source removal]` (and the regex `^\[#4610\]` → `^\[dual-source removal\]`) | 94 → 94 |
| P5 | `ui/strictness-batch14.test.ts:395` | `ui/notification.zod.ts` and `ui/sharing.zod.ts`, each whole | `#5015` → `no-door retirement` | 48, 103 and 24, 114 → the same |
| P6 | `ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts:322` (the opaque line's `ruling`) | the assertion at `:417` | `#21704` → `the five members the last typing stage stopped on` (the regex follows) | the one `ruling` value → the same |

What each number meant, now said in words:
- **P1, P2.** The cloud card is the one that ruled the build-progress phase vocabulary in and owns where the emitter sits; the docblock says both. Block 2 of the objectui card is the piece that admits `verify` in `extractBuildProgress`, the consumer's strict parse.
- **P3.** The sibling this verb copies is `IAutomationService.cancelRun` / `restoreConsumedSuspension`, as the automation-service contract declared them.
- **P4.** The `./ui` `Notification` / `NotificationConfig` wrappers were removed as dual-source, and the note's label now says so.
- **P5.** `NotificationActionSchema` and `EmbedConfigSchema` were retired because they had no authoring door (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove). Both modules record that retirement in the same four places as before.
- **P6.** The decision card is the one on the five `ComponentPropsMap` members the last typing stage stopped on. The record id `5979239990` stays.

**Readers beyond the claim's "about" lines.** The claim lists `build-progress.zod.ts` about `:8`, `:27`, `:85` and `sharing.zod.ts` about `:24`. The old needles also matched `build-progress.zod.ts` 77, 84, 108, 123 and 177, and `sharing.zod.ts` 114. Leaving any of those would have made the new needle match fewer places than the old one, which is a stronger test, not the same one. So they move too, inside the two files the claim admits. Nothing outside the claim's files moves except the two generated pages, both written by `gen:docs` only: `ai/build-progress.mdx`, as the claim names, and `ui/sharing.mdx`, which renders the `sharing.zod.ts` module docblock.

**Shipped text that moved.** This is listed for the review.
- `build-progress.zod.ts`: the module docblock (lines 8, 27, 77, 84, 85), the `BUILD_PROGRESS_PHASES` docblock (108, 123) and the `hop` field docblock (177).
- `approval-service.ts`: the `continueRestoredRun` docblock (999), which `dist/contracts/index.d.ts` carries.
- `notification.zod.ts`: comment lines 48, 94 and 103.
- `sharing.zod.ts`: module docblock line 24 and comment line 114.
- The `ai/build-progress` reference page's `description:` front matter now ends with "(the cloud build-progress card, ruling A)". `page-description.ts` strips only a parenthetical that holds a tracker or ADR id, so the words now stay in the description.

No `.describe()` string moves.

**Ids that stay on those lines on purpose.** These are comment citations that no test matches, so they are not needles: `#15389` and decision batch `#106` beside P3, and the other ids in the same docblocks.

## Class (e) regrowth

`(#22110)` is dropped from the two titles. Each already states that card's decision: a flow text slot reads `{{ }}` holes and refuses a single-brace token. Read with the card's 17 comments and its landing record. There is no reader: a `git grep -F` of each old title and of each distinctive head finds only the literal itself. The lit control `composeStacks` is found in `stack.zod.ts`; the dark control exits 1.

## Text only, proven

- **Byte level, all 13 edited files.** `subst31.cjs` applies the plan to the base text and compares the result with the head. The plan was written at 15:48:21Z, before any edit: 31 spans, each required to occur exactly once on its base line. The result is 13/13 SAME, line counts unchanged, including both generated pages and the `description:` line exactly as predicted. Every old span carries an id, and no new span carries `#` plus digits.
- **Controls, 9/9 as predicted.** One character in an unplanned comment, an id appended inside a new span, a reverted span, an inserted line, trailing whitespace, a generated page edited off-plan, a plan with an absent span and a plan with an id in a new span all go red. The unmodified copy reads SAME.
- **Stage 28's `textonly28.cjs`, byte-identical**, on the 7 test files: 5 SAME (2 title, 5 declared changes). `notification.test.ts` and the component-props pin stop at their regex reader lines (134, 417), because that instrument masks string tokens, not regex literals. With only those two lines put back to base, both read SAME (1 declared change each).
- **Per-file test counts and status sequences**, base vs head, 7 files, `--project local --project repo`, JSON reporter: 193 / 193, identical in 7/7. Two fullNames change (the two titles) and 0 differ from the plan. There are 0 duplicate fullNames on either side. Names carrying `#` plus digits: 2 at base, 0 at head.

## Same strength, proven

**Places.** `sites31.cjs` finds every place each needle matches, inside the exact text its test reads. The old needles' places at base equal the new needles' places at head, pair by pair (the table above). Each new needle has 0 places at base, and each old needle has 0 at head.

**Mutations.** Each leg goes through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which requires the anchor count, restores to `HEAD` and proves blob == HEAD after every leg. The test reads the source with `readFileSync` from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the test. The predictions were written at 15:55:52Z, before the first run. The same matrix ran at the head and, with the worktree detached at the base, at the base:

| drift | base | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| P1, every place | red | red |
| P1, one place (84) of seven | green | green |
| P2 | red | red |
| P3 | red | red |
| P4, the label (the anti-vacuity test and 4 more go red) | red | red |
| P5, both places in `notification.zod.ts` | red | red |
| P5, both places in `sharing.zod.ts` | red | red |
| P5, one place (48) of two | green | green |
| P6, the assertion text | red | red |
| P6, the `ruling` value | red | red |

- **Result:** 10/10 at the head and 10/10 at the base, as predicted. Every red fails on the needle assertion itself.
- **The null legs:** the first P2 leg at the head never ran. `ablation-replace` refused it, because its replacement was a substring of the anchor. The base P2 leg as first written had the same defect and was not run. Both were re-anchored with a replacement that is not a substring, and that amendment was written down before the re-run, with the prediction unchanged.
- **Restore:** after the matrix the worktree is back on the branch at `fbec38c32`, and `git status` is clean.

## Verification at `fbec38c32`

ESLint's own config reports 11 configured, 0 ignored and 0 with type-aware parser options, so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The 3 Markdown files are outside ESLint's config.
- **Control bytes:** the scan over the 14 changed files finds 0. `check:nul-bytes` (in the derived set) exits 0.

## Patch round at `a766d439f` (open question answered A, ACCEPT `6085085283`)

One span on one line, `system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:497`: `(ruling record 6070963704, #22211 A):` becomes `(ruling record 6070963704, letter A):`. The commit is `a766d439f`, on top of `fbec38c32`, with no merge of `main` (the PR reported no conflict, and `git merge-tree` onto `origin/main` `446c8b2a6` is clean).

- **Text only, byte level:** the one-span plan, written at 16:36:23Z before the edit, applied to `fbec38c32`, equals the head: SAME, 1616 lines on both sides. A control that re-adds an id inside the span reads DIFFERENT. Stage 28's `textonly28.cjs` with line 497 declared reads SAME (552 string tokens, 1 changed, declared); without the declaration it refuses the line, as it should.
- **No reader:** a `git grep -F` of the old text, and of the value's opening words, finds only the literal itself. No assertion reads the text, only its length (more than 20).
- **That file's tests:** 76 / 76 passed at base and head, under `--project local --project repo`. The status sequence is identical and no fullName changed.
- **Census:** `census28.cjs` at the head reads **4 / 4 in 2 files**, the 4 named hex colours. The same instrument reads 5 / 5 at `fbec38c32` and 13 / 13 at the base `e148ca984`.
- **Full runs at `a766d439f`:**
  - workspace build: 71/71;
  - spec typecheck: exit 0, with `check:test-typecheck` at 52 / 246 / 135 held, and the patched file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program;
  - spec `--project local`: 630 files, 18798 passed, 1 todo;

  - `check:generated`: all 15 up to date.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derives the same 109 commands, all exit 0, and `--ran` reads 109 / 109 / 0 NOT-MEASURED. The 6 directory-sharing roster families also exit 0. ESLint over the file: 0 / 0; it is configured, not ignored and not type-aware.
- **CI on `a766d439f`** at 17:05Z: 33 success, 2 skipped, none red. On `fbec38c32`, the push of `a766d439f` cancelled 14 jobs, and the aggregate `TypeScript Type Check` job failed at its "Verify every type-check lane succeeded" step because its lanes were cancelled. That red is on the superseded head only.
